NHK Spring.why: Makes HDD suspensions; demand for suspensions for high-capacity HDDs is expanding on AI-related and data-center storage demand and the company is adding suspension capacity in Japan, overseas and Thailand.
NHK Spring.evidence: NHK Spring release 07-16-2026: new HDD suspension production building at the NHK Spring Thailand Wellgrow plant (about 150 oku yen; about 350 oku yen in total planned), on expected demand growth for high-capacity HDDs from AI-related applications and data centers.

players.product: HDD suspensions (Disk Drive Suspension business) for high-capacity HDDs used in AI-related applications and data centers

quarterly_data.signal: NHK Spring will build a new HDD suspension production building at the Wellgrow plant of NHK Spring Thailand (Bang Pakong, Chachoengsao, Thailand): about JPY 15 billion (150 oku yen) for the building, as part of a stepwise total of about JPY 35 billion (350 oku yen) of manufacturing-equipment investment for future demand; site area about 6,000 m2; completion scheduled for December 2027. The building consolidates the visual-inspection process, freeing space so that the site's HDD suspension production capacity can be expanded up to 1.6 times.
quarterly_data.figure: about 150 oku yen for the building; about 350 oku yen in total; capacity up to 1.6 times; completion December 2027

quarterly_data.signal: Company: driven by expanding demand for AI-related applications and data centers, the high-capacity HDD market is expected to see demand expansion; the new building is built with future demand in view.
